description: Resolve a Tango @handle (worker, teammate, or client) to a UUID. Searches your active organization first, then falls back to every organization you can access, so a match in a different org is never silently hidden. Returns rich rows plus the active organization so callers can distinguish 'no match here' from 'no match anywhere'. Use before create_task or handoff_task when you only know a name.

agency_id.description: Restrict resolution to a specific organization (skips the global fallback).
